title: Personalized Basketball Shattered Glass Comforter with Name and Number
description:
Bring the energy of the court right into your bedroom with this custom sports bedding set by Jeminise. Perfect for basketball players and fans of all ages, this comforter set adds a personalized touch to your space, featuring a realistic graphic of a basketball breaking through glass.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize this sports bedding with your own name and sports jersey number for a truly unique look.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with a whole-piece microfiber filling that prevents clumping or shifting.
  • Superior Craftsmanship: Features advanced environmental protection printing techniques to hold dye and prevent fading, finished with smooth, tight stitching along the edges.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; dries quickly and fluffs up beautifully after air drying without heat.
  • Included Components: Comes as a single duvet cover or comforter with customizable options for pillowcases and flat sheets.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Cotton/ Polyester
Color Basketball D18
Pattern Basketball Print
Style Decor
Theme Personalized
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
